title: Trace of the verdict machine
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $i$ be one of the $k$ work tapes, and let $d$ be a configuration of the verdict machine with state left. Suppose the cell immediately to the left of tape $i$'s head contains the Boolean $b$. For every natural number $t\le 2$, the configuration after $t$ steps is $d$ if $t=0$; if $t=1$, only the state changes to read and tape $i$'s head moves left by one; and if $t=2$, the state is done with value $b$, that cell is erased, and the head remains at the cell it reached after the first step.
hypotheses_covered: The initial state of $d$ is left
The cell at tape $i$'s head position minus one contains $b$
